title: Knowledge or Calculator? Decomposing the Skill Premium in Verifiable Financial Agent Workflows
title_zh: Knowledge或Calculator? 解构可验证金融代理工作流程中的技能溢价

paragraphs.en: Financial AI agents must do more than retrieve facts: investment workflows require correct quantitative execution, reliable use of procedural resources, and auditable structured outputs. We introduce FinSkillBench , an evaluation suite of 2,603 point in time episodes across 12 subtasks in portfolio construction, risk management, and fundamental analysis, with hidden regenerable ground truth and task specific deterministic verifiers. Executing 17,820 episodes across 9 models and 3 resource conditions, the paired analysis across 8 models shows that curated skill packages raise mean scores by +16.2 points (0.366 to 0.528), whereas skills generated within a single episode add only +0.5 points while consuming more tokens and turns. We then decompose the curated premium by granting human authored procedural documents and executable domain tools separately: documents alone add +5.6 points, tools alone add +19.5 points, and their combination is subadditive. The premium is strongly workflow dependent: executable tools dominate numerically intensive workflows, documentation matters more when procedural or output schema guidance is the bottleneck, and interpretive tasks benefit from both. The effects are sign stable across 10 scoring variants and cluster bootstrap analyses, and an independently implemented second harness reproduces the directional pattern while showing that effect magnitudes depend on how tools and data are exposed. Overall, a measured “skill premium” is a property of the full model, resource, and harness system rather than of the underlying model alone. A focused composed-workflow probe reinforces this: chaining the same curated-skill subtasks into a nine-stage mandate-delivery process, an agent running on its own handoffs delivers a near-optimal but never mandate-adherent book (optimality 0.934, adherence 0/33) while every per-stage control reports success. We will release the benchmark, skill packages, verifiers, scorers, and evaluation artifacts upon publication.
paragraphs.zh: 金融智能体必须做的不仅仅是检索事实：投资工作流程需要正确的量化执行、可靠的过程资源使用以及可审计的结构化输出。 我们提出了 FinSkillBench，这是一个评估套件，包含 12 个子任务（涵盖投资组合构建、风险管理和基本面分析）中的 2,603 个时点场景，并配有隐藏的可再生基准答案和任务特定的确定性验证器。 在 9 个模型和 3 种资源条件下执行了 17,820 个场景后，对 8 个模型的配对分析显示，精心设计的技能包使平均得分提升了 +16.2 分（从 0.366 到 0.528），而单个场景内生成的技能仅能增加 +0.5 分，同时消耗更多令牌和步骤。 接着，我们通过分别提供人类编写的过程文档和可执行领域工具，对精心设计的技能溢价进行了分解：仅文档可增加 +5.6 分，仅工具可增加 +19.5 分，而两者的组合效果并非简单相加。 这种溢价强烈依赖工作流程：在数值计算密集的工作流程中，可执行工具更为关键；当过程或输出格式指导成为瓶颈时，文档的重要性更高；而在解释性任务中，两者均能带来益处。 这些效应在 10 种评分变体和聚类自助分析中均保持稳定，且一个独立实现的第二个测试框架重现了这种方向性模式，同时表明效应大小取决于工具和数据的呈现方式。 总体而言，可测量的“技能溢价”是整个模型、资源和测试系统共同具备的特性，而非仅由底层模型决定。 一项针对组合工作流程的专项测试进一步证实了这一点：将相同的精心设计的子任务串联成一个九阶段的指令执行流程时，仅依赖自身交接环节的智能体虽然能生成接近最优但完全不符合指令要求的投资组合（最优性 0.934，合规性 0/33），而每个阶段的单独控制却均报告成功。 我们将在论文发表后发布该基准、技能包、验证器、评分器和评估相关成果。

paragraphs.en: Large language models are increasingly used as planning and analysis agents. In investment management, such agents are asked to solve tasks with quantitative structure: construct an optimal portfolio, monitor mandate violations, estimate stress losses, compute earnings-quality metrics, and normalize XBRL filings. These tasks differ from open-ended financial question answering: they require point-in-time discipline, structured outputs, reliable tool use, and verifiable numerical or symbolic correctness. Existing evaluations often ask whether a model knows financial concepts or can answer finance questions. That is necessary but insufficient for evaluating agentic investment workflows. A useful investment agent must know when to load domain procedures, how to pass large numeric inputs without corrupting them, which formula applies to a filing metric, and how to return a result that can be audited by downstream software. The evaluation object is therefore not only the model, but the full process by which a model uses tools, documentation, and reusable skills.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用作规划和分析智能体。 在投资管理领域，这类智能体需要解决具有量化结构的任务：构建最优投资组合、监控授权违规情况、估算压力测试下的损失、计算盈利质量指标，以及对 XBRL 申报文件进行标准化处理。 这些任务与开放式金融问答不同：它们要求特定时间点的严谨性、结构化的输出、可靠的工具使用能力，以及可验证的数值或符号正确性。 现有的评估通常关注模型是否了解金融概念，或者能否回答金融问题。 这对评估智能体驱动的投资工作流程而言是必要的，但还不够充分。 一个实用的投资智能体必须知道何时调用领域内程序、如何传递大数值输入而不导致数据损坏、哪种公式适用于申报文件中的某个指标，以及如何返回可供下游软件审计的结果。 因此，评估对象不仅是模型本身，还包括模型使用工具、文档和可复用技能的全过程。

paragraphs.en: Financial AI has meanwhile moved beyond isolated prediction and question answering toward increasingly structured decision-support settings. Prior work has studied relational and geometric models for market prediction and financial news ( Sun et al., 2023b ; Harit et al., 2024b ; Harit et al., 2025 ) , financial recommendation ( Sun and Harit, 2025 ) , and the stability of financial NLP under semantic shift ( Sun et al., 2025b ) . These developments make a broader question increasingly important: not only whether an AI model can produce a useful financial prediction, but whether a complete AI workflow remains reliable when it must retrieve information, invoke procedures and tools, and compose intermediate decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，金融人工智能已超越孤立的预测和问答阶段，逐步迈向结构化的决策支持场景。 先前的研究探讨了市场预测和金融新闻的关系模型与几何模型（Sun et al., 2023b; Harit et al., 2024b; Harit et al., 2025）、金融推荐（Sun and Harit, 2025），以及语义变化下金融自然语言处理的稳定性（Sun et al., 2025b）。 这些进展使得一个更广泛的问题日益重要：不仅在于人工智能模型能否生成有用的金融预测，更在于当工作流程需要检索信息、调用程序与工具并组合中间决策时，整个流程是否仍能保持可靠。

paragraphs.en: We study this process through FinSkillBench , a benchmark and evaluation protocol for AI agents in investment management. The benchmark is organized around three domains: portfolio construction (mean-variance optimization, constrained optimization, tool-call parameterization, rebalancing, and Black–Litterman allocation), risk management (mandate monitoring, risk identification, stress testing, and remediation trades), and fundamental analysis (XBRL metric normalization, earnings quality, and driver decomposition). 1 1 1 For readers outside finance: Black–Litterman blends market-equilibrium returns with investor views; mandate monitoring checks a portfolio against client-imposed constraints; XBRL is the structured tagging format for SEC filings; the Piotroski F-Score and Beneish M-Score are published accounting screens for fundamental strength and earnings-manipulation risk.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 FinSkillBench 研究这一过程，这是一个用于评估投资管理中人工智能智能体的基准和评估协议。 该基准围绕三个领域展开：投资组合构建（均值-方差优化、约束优化、工具调用参数化、再平衡以及布莱克-利特曼配置）、风险管理（授权监控、风险识别、压力测试和纠正性交易）以及基本面分析（XBRL 指标标准化、盈利质量和驱动因素分解）。1 1 1 对于非金融领域的读者：布莱克-利特曼模型将市场均衡回报与投资者观点相结合；授权监控用于检查投资组合是否符合客户设定的约束条件；XBRL 是用于美国证券交易委员会申报的结构化标签格式；皮奥特罗斯基 F 分数和贝内什 M 分数则是用于评估基本面强度和盈利操纵风险的公开会计指标。

paragraphs.en: The key intervention is skill availability . In the no-skill condition, the agent receives the task without curated skill documents or domain-specific tools; shared data-retrieval tools remain available. In the curated condition, it can discover and load human-authored skill documents and tool scripts. In the self-generated condition, it must first write skill documents for itself and then use them. Two further arms, docs-only and tools-only , complete a controlled decomposition that separates written procedural knowledge from executable tools (Sec. 4 ). This design evaluates not just “Can the model solve the task?” but “Does a reusable skill layer improve agentic financial analysis, which component of the layer does the work, and under what assumptions?”
paragraphs.zh: 关键干预措施是技能的可获取性。 在无技能条件下，智能体在没有任何精选技能文档或领域特定工具的情况下接收任务；共享的数据检索工具仍然可用。 在精选条件下，它可以发现并加载由人类编写的技能文档和工具脚本。 在自生成条件下，它必须首先为自己编写技能文档，然后使用这些文档。 另外两个分支——仅文档和仅工具——完成了一种受控的分解，将书面程序性知识与可执行工具分离开来（第 4 节）。 这种设计不仅评估了“模型能否解决该任务？”，还评估了“可重用的技能层是否提升了智能体的金融分析能力？该技能的哪个组件完成了工作？其前提假设是什么？”

paragraphs.en: We treat skill availability as a controlled resource intervention. paragraphs.en: As a composed-process extension, we chain the same curated-skill subtasks into a single nine-stage mandate-delivery workflow and use a teacher-forced versus autonomous contrast to show that near-ceiling per-subtask scores need not compose: running on its own handoffs, the agent produces near-optimal but never mandate-adherent books while every per-stage control reports success—a failure mode we call silent competence .
paragraphs.zh: 作为一个组合流程扩展，我们将相同的精选技能子任务串联成一个包含九个阶段的指令交付工作流程，并通过“教师强制”与“自主执行”的对比表明，各子任务的分数接近上限并不必然意味着整体流程成功：当智能体仅依赖自身任务交接运行时，它生成的书籍虽近乎最优，却从未完全遵循指令；而每个阶段的控制检查均显示成功——这种失败模式我们称之为“静默能力”。

paragraphs.en: Anthropic introduced the Agent Skills specification as a format for equipping agents with reusable domain specific procedures ( Anthropic, 2025 ) . SkillsBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) evaluated this paradigm across 86 tasks and 11 general domains, finding that curated skills improve average pass rates while self generated skills provide little average benefit. We use its three condition protocol as a starting point but ask a different question: what component of a skill produces the gain in verifiable domain workflows? FinSkillBench therefore adds a controlled decomposition of written procedural guidance and executable domain tools. Its targets are also regenerable computational objects, including convex optima, Black Litterman posteriors, stress P&L, and structured accounting quantities, rather than human authored reference solutions alone.

paragraphs.en: FinQA, ConvFinQA, and TAT-QA ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2021 ) evaluate numerical reasoning over financial reports and tables. Recent benchmarks extend this to knowledge-intensive and document-grounded math reasoning (FinanceMath ( Zhao et al., 2024a ) , DocMath-Eval ( Zhao et al., 2024b ) , FinanceReasoning ( Tang et al., 2025a ) ), multimodal financial reasoning (FinMME ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , FinMMR ( Tang et al., 2025b ) , MME-Finance ( Gan et al., 2025 ) , FinMMDocR ( Tang et al., 2026 ) ), and business-driven QA (BizFinBench ( Lu et al., 2025 ) ). Recent agentic benchmarks cover financial research ( Bigeard et al., 2025 ) , spreadsheet-centric enterprise workflows ( Dong et al., 2026 ) , and executable financial tool use ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . FinSkillBench instead isolates document and tool effects through a controlled procedural-resource manipulation with point-in-time inputs, deterministic verification, and regenerable hidden ground truth.

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work studies how structured representations and model design affect robustness across complex AI tasks. Graph-based methods have addressed representation learning under structural heterogeneity ( Sun et al., 2023a ) , uncertainty and scarce supervision ( Sun et al., 2021 ) , and non-Euclidean or higher-order relational structure ( Sun et al., 2025a ; Harit and Sun, 2025 ) . Related studies have examined behavioural change as a signal of evolving system state ( Harit et al., 2024a ) and how modality-specific bias can alter model behaviour under evaluation ( Sun et al., 2022 ) . These studies primarily analyse properties of individual predictive models; FinSkillBench shifts the unit of evaluation to the composed agentic process, where representations interact with procedures, tools, intermediate outputs, and the evaluation harness itself.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项互补的研究则探讨了结构化表示和模型设计如何影响复杂人工智能任务中的鲁棒性。 基于图的方法已解决了结构异质性（Sun et al., 2023a）、不确定性和稀疏监督（Sun et al., 2021）下的表示学习问题，以及非欧几里得或更高阶的关系结构问题（Sun et al., 2025a; Harit and Sun, 2025）。 相关研究已考察行为变化作为系统状态演变的信号（Harit et al., 2024a），以及模态特定偏见如何在评估中改变模型行为（Sun et al., 2022）。 这些研究主要分析单个预测模型的特性；FinSkillBench则将评估单位转向了复合的智能体过程，其中表示会与流程、工具、中间输出以及评估框架本身相互作用。

paragraphs.en: Tasks are anchored in three data substrates. Portfolio construction and risk management use a market stack (daily prices, Fama–French factors ( Fama and French, 1993 ) , macroeconomic series) from which we derive a Ledoit–Wolf shrinkage covariance ( Ledoit and Wolf, 2004 ) , rolling factor exposures, a composite fundamentals-plus-momentum expected-return view, and a market-cap benchmark proxy. Fundamental analysis uses a reporting stack built from SEC EDGAR submissions and XBRL CompanyFacts. Risk management additionally relies on constructed objects , synthetic portfolios with planted risk profiles, mandate specifications, and stress-scenario definitions, which capture institutional middle-office inputs without conflating the task with filing parsing.
paragraphs.zh: 任务基于三种数据底稿展开。 投资组合构建和风险管理使用一套市场数据（每日价格、Fama–French因子（Fama和French，1993）、宏观经济序列），由此我们推导出Ledoit–Wolf收缩协方差矩阵（Ledoit和Wolf，2004）、滚动因子敞口、一种结合基本面与动量的复合预期回报观点，以及一个以市值为基准的代理指标。 基本面分析使用一套基于SEC EDGAR提交数据和XBRL CompanyFacts构建的报告数据。 风险管理还依赖于一系列构造对象：植入特定风险特征的合成投资组合、授权规格以及压力情景定义，这些对象能够捕捉机构中台部门的输入信息，同时避免将任务与文件解析混为一谈。

paragraphs.en: Three design choices govern the data flow. First, all episodes carry an explicit as_of_date ; system prompts forbid reliance on post-date information and tooling returns only point-in-time slices. Second, task prompts apply lossy compaction to large numeric structures (a covariance matrix is summarized in the visible prompt, while available at full precision through tool calls). This separation measures whether agents retrieve and pipe accurate numeric input rather than reasoning from rounded text. Third, the universe is a fixed 30-name sector-stratified sample S&P 500, sacrificing breadth for controlled and reproducible evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 三种设计选择决定了数据流。 首先，所有剧集都携带一个明确的 as_of_date；系统提示禁止依赖日期之后的信息，工具也仅返回特定时间点的切片数据。 其次，任务提示会对大型数值结构进行有损压缩（协方差矩阵会在可见提示中做摘要呈现，但通过工具调用可获得完整精度的数据）。 这种分离机制用于衡量智能体是否能够获取并传递准确的数值输入，而不是基于四舍五入后的文本进行推理。 第三，整个宇宙是一个固定包含 30 个名称的按行业分层抽样标普 500 指数，此举牺牲了广度，以换取受控且可重复的评估环境。

paragraphs.en: We define a skill as one domain level package containing a SKILL.md document and associated executable Python entry points. FinSkillBench contains three curated skills, one each for portfolio construction, risk management, and fundamental analysis, covering five, four, and three subtasks, respectively. The packages were authored specifically for FinSkillBench by the benchmark developers. Each package combines declarative content (Markdown procedures, formulas, common failure modes, API usage patterns) and imperative content (small validated Python entry points invoked through a constrained script-execution tool with JSON I/O). The split addresses a failure mode observed in piloting: language models reliably invent the shape of a computation but fail to pass large numeric structures through tool calls at full precision. For example, a 900-float covariance matrix emitted by a model and re-parsed into an optimizer differs from the source at the last few digits, and those differences change the optimum. The curated design therefore keeps numeric-heavy routines inside validated scripts, with server-side injection of full-precision task fields (no round-trip through model-generated JSON).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将技能定义为包含一个 SKILL.md 文档和相关可执行 Python 入口点的单一领域层级包。 FinSkillBench 包含三个经过精心挑选的技能，分别用于投资组合构建、风险管理和基本面分析，涵盖五个、四个和三个子任务。 这些包由基准测试开发者专门针对 FinSkillBench 编写。 每个包都结合了声明式内容（Markdown 流程、公式、常见失败模式、API 使用模式）和命令式内容（通过受约束的脚本执行工具调用并带有 JSON I/O 的小型验证过的 Python 入口点）。 这种拆分解决了在试点阶段观察到的一个失败模式：语言模型能够可靠地生成计算的结构，但无法以完整精度通过工具调用传递大型数值结构。 例如，模型生成的一个包含 900 个浮点数的协方差矩阵，在被重新解析到优化器时，最后几位数字会与原始数据不同，而这些差异会改变最优解。 因此，这种精心设计的方案将数值密集型操作保留在已验证的脚本内部，并通过服务器端注入完整精度的任务字段（无需经过模型生成的 JSON 往返传输）。

paragraphs.en: The agent follows a function-calling, ReAct-style loop with a common task interface and shared retrieval and submission tools. Condition-specific interfaces expose skill discovery and loading, skill authoring (self-generated only), and executable domain tools according to the assigned resource condition. Shared tools retrieve full task fields and domain data, while curated script execution is scoped to the active skill directory. Turn budget is capped at 12 with up to 3 retries for transient provider failures. Episodes that fail to emit valid JSON through the submission tool are scored invalid_submission or incomplete_submission rather than silently dropped.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体遵循一种函数调用、ReAct 风格的循环，采用通用的任务接口以及共享的检索和提交工具。 根据分配的资源条件，特定条件的接口会提供技能发现与加载、技能编写（仅限自生成）以及可执行领域工具。 共享工具可检索完整的任务字段和领域数据，而经过筛选的脚本执行则限定在当前的技能目录中。 轮次预算上限为 12 次，对于临时性的提供商故障最多允许重试 3 次。 若某个回合未能通过提交工具输出有效的 JSON，则会被标记为 invalid_submission 或 incomplete_submission，而非静默丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Skill effects are heterogeneous across base models. claude-sonnet-4.6 starts from the strongest no skill baseline (0.534), while gpt-4.1 shows the largest raw curated difference (+0.405) from the weakest no skill baseline among the six models without severe execution failures (0.330). A start-of-run scheduling artifact caused 61% of gpt-5.4 ’s curated skill-script executions to record spurious 30-second timeouts (under 1% for every other model; zero of 66 replayed timeouts reproduce), depressing its curated cells on 8 of 12 subtasks, and three scorer definitions penalize verbose responders most (Sec. 8.3 ).

paragraphs.en: In a sensitivity re-analysis that repairs all four issues, gpt-5.4 ’s curated mean rises from 0.520 to 0.680, and the top six curated scores fall within a band of 0.10 spanning frontier, mid, and economical model tiers. paragraphs.en: Overall, the premium splits into a documents effect of + 0.056 +0.056 , a tools effect of + 0.195 +0.195 , and an interaction of − 0.089 -0.089 . Three findings structure it by investment-management workflow. First , knowledge-bound middle-office tasks are carried by documents: on risk identification, docs-only scores 0.382, the highest of all conditions, while tools-only reaches only 0.029. Second , computational tasks are carried by tools: on stress testing, tools-only scores 0.469 against 0.086 for docs-only, with the same pattern on constrained optimization (0.629 vs. 0.176), rebalancing, and Black-Litterman. Third , interpretive fundamental-analysis tasks need both: the combined package is best on earnings quality (0.535) and driver decomposition (0.322), while normalization stays flat across the no-skill, docs, tools, and curated conditions (0.676-0.681) because the global XBRL tool already covers it. A trace audit qualifies the risk-identification result: its verifier matches a four-label vocabulary that the RM SKILL.md states verbatim, and in the cross-harness arms (Sec. 7 ) the share of predicted labels outside that vocabulary falls from 85% to 34% when the document is present. Thus, part of the document effect there is supplying the output ontology the verifier scores against, not only analytical procedure (cf. Sec. 8.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，溢价可分为文档效应 +0.056、工具效应 +0.195 以及交互效应 −0.089。 三项发现依据投资管理流程对其进行了结构化分析。 首先，知识密集型中台任务由文档承担：在风险识别方面，仅使用文档的得分为 0.382，在所有条件下最高；而仅使用工具的得分仅为 0.029。 其次，计算任务由工具承担：在压力测试中，仅使用工具的得分为 0.469，而仅使用文档的得分为 0.086；在约束优化（0.629 对比 0.176）、再平衡以及 Black-Litterman 模型中也呈现出相同模式。 第三，解释性的基本面分析任务需要两者结合：组合方案在盈利质量（0.535）和驱动因素分解（0.322）方面表现最佳；而在归一化方面，无技能、文档、工具和精选条件下的得分均保持平稳（0.676-0.681），因为全局 XBRL 工具已涵盖该任务。 一次追溯审计对风险识别的结果进行了验证：其验证器匹配了 RM SKILL.md 中明确列出的四个标签词汇表；在跨工具集对比中（第 7 节），当文档存在时，预测标签超出该词汇表的比例从 85% 下降至 34%。 因此，文档效应的一部分在于提供了验证器所依据的输出本体，而不仅仅是分析流程（参见第 8.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: The negative interaction reflects a real cost. Under the fixed 12 turn budget, adding documents to tools reduces scores on several computation subtasks, including stress testing from 0.469 to 0.281, because discovery and reading compete with execution turns. Stacking procedural resources is therefore not free. The decomposition also sharpens the self generation result. The docs only and self generated conditions both lack executable scripts and share the global XBRL tool, yet score 0.422 versus 0.371 overall and 0.382 versus 0.055 on risk identification. This difference is consistent with document quality and in episode authoring cost rather than executable tool access. The tools only condition exposes domain tools directly, whereas the curated condition routes them through run_skill_script . The comparison between these conditions therefore also includes a difference in how tools are accessed, consistent with the cross harness results in Sec. 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 这种负面互动反映了实际存在的成本。 在固定的 12 轮预算下，将文档添加到工具中会降低多个计算子任务的得分，包括压力测试得分从 0.469 降至 0.281，因为发现和阅读会与执行轮次产生竞争。 因此，叠加程序性资源并非免费。 这种分解也提升了自生成结果的准确性。 “仅文档”和“自生成”两种情况都缺乏可执行的脚本，并且共享全局 XBRL 工具，但整体得分分别为 0.422 和 0.371，在风险识别方面的得分分别为 0.382 和 0.055。 这种差异与文档质量和单集创作成本相关，而非可执行工具的访问权限。 “仅工具”情况直接暴露了领域工具，而“精选”情况则通过 run_skill_script 来调用这些工具。 因此，这些情况之间的比较也包含了工具访问方式上的差异，这与第 7 节中的跨工具测试结果一致。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the no-skill vs. curated effect is robust to agent-implementation choices, we replicate the comparison on an independent harness: the Nous Research Hermes Agent ( Nous Research, 2026 ) with the same domain skills, tools, prompt template, submission protocol, and turn budget (max_turns = = 12); only the Hermes skills_list and skill_view tools were activated, with all other built-in skills, toolsets, memory and personality off. Because episode coverage differs between conditions, the cross-condition mean differences below are descriptive rather than matched treatment-effect estimates.

paragraphs.en: Curated skill gains are not pure knowledge gains: skills combine procedural guidance, tool-use instructions, executable scripts, and failure-mode warnings, and Sec. 6.6 quantifies how the credit splits. The pattern is specific to investment workflows. Portfolio construction and stress testing depend on precise point-in-time numerics and therefore favor executable tools, while risk identification depends more on risk taxonomy and output ontology and therefore favors documents. Interpretive fundamental-analysis tasks benefit from both, while normalization gains little because shared XBRL retrieval already covers much of the workflow. Thus, the value of a financial skill depends on whether the bottleneck is procedural categorization, numerical execution, or interpretation.

paragraphs.en: The self-generated condition supports a specific claim: within a 12-turn episode, unvalidated agent-written documents – authored, reloaded, and applied under the same budget – do not match pre-tested documents plus executable solvers. The same-access comparison in Sec. 6.6 (docs-only 0.422 vs. self-generated 0.371, with equal script access) locates the gap in document quality and authoring cost rather than tool access. A smaller follow-up experiment (4 models, 384 paired cells, document truncation removed) refines the null: self-generation there shows a small positive effect over no skill ( + 0.039 +0.039 [ + 0.015 +0.015 , + 0.064 +0.064 ]), and capability-matched human-authored documents beat agent-authored ones by + 0.066 +0.066 [ + 0.043 +0.043 , + 0.090 +0.090 ]. Self-generated skills may also still help in a multi-episode setting where skills persist, are tested, and are corrected over time; this benchmark does not evaluate that scenario.

paragraphs.en: The benchmark demonstrates that conclusions about “financial agent capability” depend strongly on evaluation design. For example: if invalid and max-turn submissions are dropped, score estimates are inflated relative to deployment-like reliability, and if no-skill agents can call the same deterministic solvers as curated agents, the measured skill effect is confounded. A post-hoc trace audit of the full run makes this concrete. The scoring pipeline reproduces stored scores exactly (135 sampled episodes, zero mismatches), but three metric definitions partly scored presentation rather than analysis: stress testing compared answers against fractional ground truth while the prompt’s input data used whole-number percent with no declared convention, risk identification matched labels by exact string equality, and parameter_match counted unrequested extra keys against the score. Correcting all three identically for every model moves the pooled curated effect over the six models without severe execution failures from + 0.218 +0.218 to + 0.192 +0.192 : risk identification moves from + 0.376 +0.376 to + 0.079 +0.079 , stress testing from + 0.321 +0.321 to + 0.181 +0.181 , tool-use parameterization by + 0.010 +0.010 , and the remaining nine subtasks are unchanged. The primary tables retain the original scorer specification to preserve the evaluation protocol used in the main run. We report the later rescoring as a post hoc sensitivity analysis and will release both versions with the harness. These issues motivated the corrected scorer definitions and illustrate why evaluation artifacts need documented assumptions, not just leaderboards.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试表明，关于“金融智能体能力”的结论在很大程度上取决于评估设计。 例如：如果无效提交和最大轮次提交被剔除，那么得分估计值相对于部署环境中的实际可靠性会被高估；如果无技能智能体能够调用与精选智能体相同的确定性求解器，则测得的能力效应就会受到混淆。 对完整运行过程的事后追踪审计使这一问题具体化。 评分流程完全复现了已存储的得分（135个采样回合，零不匹配），但三种指标定义部分衡量的是呈现而非分析：压力测试将答案与分数形式的基准真相进行比较，而提示词中的输入数据使用了整数百分比且未声明任何约定；风险识别通过精确字符串相等性匹配标签；参数匹配则将对未请求的额外键也计入了得分。 对所有模型统一修正这三个指标后，六个无严重执行失败的模型中精选智能体的综合效应从+0.218 +0.218变为+0.192 +0.192：风险识别从+0.376 +0.376变为+0.079 +0.079，压力测试从+0.321 +0.321变为+0.181 +0.181，工具使用参数化提升+0.010 +0.010，其余九个子任务保持不变。 主要表格保留了原始的评分器规范，以维持主运行中使用的评估协议。 我们将后续的重评分作为事后敏感性分析进行报告，并会与测试框架一同发布两个版本。 这些问题促使我们修正了评分器定义，也说明了为何评估结果需要记录明确的假设，而不仅仅是依赖排行榜。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, this extends earlier concerns about robustness to representation, data, and distributional variation ( Sun et al., 2025b ; sun2022unimodalbias ) : in agentic systems, the evaluation interface and execution environment themselves become additional sources of variation.

paragraphs.en: All results here measure a single-agent performance effect: one agent, exogenous prices. In deployment, many agents holding the same packages would trade in the same markets. Because FinSkillBench provides a population of agents with controllable, measured behavioral differences on a shared point-in-time data stack, a natural follow-up varies the share of skill-equipped agents in a multi-agent rebalancing loop with a price-impact model, asking whether the premium survives crowding; we leave this analysis to ongoing work.
paragraphs.zh: 此处的所有结果都衡量的是单智能体性能效应：一个智能体，外生价格。 在实际部署中，持有相同组合的多个智能体将在同一市场进行交易。 由于 FinSkillBench 提供了一个由智能体组成的群体，这些智能体在共享的实时数据栈上具有可控制且可测量的行为差异，因此一个自然的后续研究是：在一个包含价格影响模型的多智能体再平衡循环中，改变具备技能的智能体的比例，以探究这种溢价是否会在拥挤效应下仍然存在；我们将此分析留待后续工作完成。

paragraphs.en: A desk never runs these subtasks in isolation; it chains them. As a probe of whether per-subtask skill gains survive composition, we ran a focused case study, FinSkillBench-Desk , that threads the same curated-skill subtasks into a single nine-stage mandate-delivery chain—mandate parse, fundamental research, Black–Litterman view, construction, monitoring, stress, risk identification, remediation, and rebalancing—and scores the final book against a deterministic, re-derivable theoretical best. Holding the model ( gpt-4.1 ), mandate ( medium_core ), and 30-name universe fixed, we contrast a teacher-forced mode, in which each stage consumes clean oracle inputs, with an autonomous mode, in which each stage consumes the agent’s own upstream outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 桌面绝不会孤立地执行这些子任务；它会将其串联起来。 为了探究各子任务的技能增益在组合后是否仍然存在，我们开展了一项聚焦性案例研究——FinSkillBench-Desk。该研究将同一组经过筛选的技能子任务整合为一条包含九个阶段的指令执行链：指令解析、基础研究、布莱克-利特曼观点构建、构建、监控、压力测试、风险识别、修复与再平衡，并最终以确定性且可重新推导的理论最优结果对最终账本进行评分。 在保持模型（gpt-4.1）、指令（medium_core）和包含30个名称的资产池不变的前提下，我们将教师强制模式与自主模式进行了对比：在教师强制模式下，每个阶段都使用纯净的“神谕”输入；而在自主模式下，每个阶段则使用智能体自身上游阶段的输出。

paragraphs.en: The result is a composition failure that component scores do not see. Teacher-forced, the chain is fully deployable (100% mandate adherence, optimality 1.000). Autonomous, it produces books that are near-optimal in weight space (optimality 0.934) yet never mandate-adherent (0 of 33), while the entire downstream risk-management control loop (monitor, stress, risk identification, remediation) still scores 1.000 against its per-stage conditional oracle (Tables 8 and 9 ). The cause is a single seam: stage one parses the mandate into a plausible but non-canonical contract, the constraint builder silently drops the position, sector, beta, and tracking-error limits it can no longer find, and the downstream monitor then certifies compliance against the same degraded contract while its conditional oracle inherits the identical corruption. We call this silent competence : a control loop that is internally self-consistent and confident while enforcing a mandate it mis-transcribed upstream. The breach surfaces only at the terminal gate, which is scored against the immutable canonical mandate rather than the agent’s own parse.
paragraphs.zh: 其结果是一种成分评分未能察觉的组合失败。 在教师强制下，该链完全可部署（100% 指令遵从度，最优性 1.000）。 在自主模式下，它生成的书籍在权重空间中接近最优（最优性 0.934），但从未完全遵从指令（33 项中为 0）；与此同时，整个下游风险管理控制循环（监控、压力测试、风险识别与纠正）在其各阶段的条件神谕上仍获得 1.000 的评分（见表 8 和表 9）。 其根源在于一个单一断层：第一阶段将指令解析为一个看似合理但非标准的合同；约束构建器静默地丢弃了位置、行业、贝塔系数和跟踪误差等已无法找到的限制；随后下游监控器则基于这个被简化的合同认证合规性，而它的条件神谕也继承了同样的错误。 我们称之为“静默能力”：一个控制循环在内部自洽且充满自信，尽管它执行的是上游误转录的指令。 这种偏差仅在终端关口显现，该关口的评分依据是不可更改的标准指令，而非智能体自身的解析结果。

Because this is a single-model, single-mandate probe (Sec. 9 ), we read it as an existence-and-mechanism result that motivates process-level, mandate-adherence evaluation, not as a prevalence claim.
paragraphs.zh: 每个子任务的技能得分较高——即便是第 6 节中接近上限的精选得分——对于具备协调部署能力而言是必要条件，但并非充分条件；而自洽的本地监控本身并不能提供保障。 可采取的具体行动非常明确：监督合同解析与约束感知构建之间的交接过程，并依据标准指令而非智能体自身的解析结果来推动合规性检查。 由于这是一项单一模型、单一指令的探索（第 9 节），我们将其解读为一个关于存在性与机制的结果，该结果为流程层面和指令遵循性评估提供了依据，而非一项普遍性结论。

paragraphs.en: The composition result (Sec. 8.4 ) is a single-model, single-mandate, single-universe case study ( gpt-4.1 , medium_core , 30 names): it establishes the existence and mechanism of silent competence, not its prevalence across models or difficulty tiers. paragraphs.en: We introduced FinSkillBench , a controlled evaluation suite for verifiable financial agent workflows with point in time inputs, regenerable hidden ground truth, and task specific deterministic verification. Across 9 models and 17,820 episodes, curated skill packages raise mean scores by +16.2 points (0.366 to 0.528) in the paired analysis across 8 models, while self generated skills add only +0.5 points. Under the bounded single episode setting studied here, agent generated procedural documents do not reproduce the benefit of pre built curated resources. The benefit of a curated package is also not a single procedural knowledge effect. Documents alone add +5.6 points, executable tools alone add +19.5 points, and their combination is subadditive. The source of the premium depends on the workflow, with numerically intensive tasks benefiting primarily from executable resources, documentation mattering more when procedural or schema level guidance is the bottleneck, and interpretive workflows benefiting from both. The pattern is sign stable under 10 scorer variants, and Hermes Agent reproduced the directional pattern across 8 models with higher curated means in all three domains, while raw magnitudes vary with harness tool and data access design. A post hoc audit further shows that scorer assumptions and execution failures can move headline numbers by several points.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 FinSkillBench，这是一套受控的评估工具包，用于验证具有特定时间点输入、可再生隐藏真实数据以及任务特异性确定性验证功能的金融智能体工作流程。 在 9 个模型和 17,820 次执行中，经过精心挑选的技能包在 8 个模型的配对分析中使平均得分提升了 +16.2 分（从 0.366 到 0.528），而自生成技能仅增加了 +0.5 分。 在本研究采用的有限单次执行设定下，智能体生成的流程性文档未能重现预构建精选资源所带来的优势。 精选资源包的优势也并非单纯源于流程性知识本身。 仅文档可带来 +5.6 分的提升，仅可执行工具可带来 +19.5 分的提升，但两者结合的效果低于单独使用之和。 这种优势的来源取决于具体工作流程：数值计算密集型任务主要受益于可执行资源；当流程或模式层面上的指导成为瓶颈时，文档更为重要；而解释性工作流程则能同时从两者中获益。 这一规律在 10 种评分器变体下保持稳定，Hermes Agent 在 8 个模型中重现了方向性趋势，且在所有三个领域均显示出更高的精选资源平均得分，但具体数值大小会因所用工具和数据访问设计而异。 事后审计进一步表明，评分器的假设偏差和执行失败可能导致主要指标出现数分的波动。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, a measured skill premium is not an intrinsic property of the underlying language model. It depends on the resources available to the agent, how those resources are exposed, the interaction budget, and the evaluation contract. Agent benchmarks should therefore treat resource and harness design as part of the scientific object rather than as an implementation detail. A composed extension of the same subtasks into a nine-stage mandate-delivery chain further shows that near-ceiling per-subtask scores need not compose: a curated-skill agent running on its own handoffs delivers a near-optimal but never mandate-adherent book while every per-stage control reports success, underscoring that process-level, canonically-anchored adherence testing—not per-skill accuracy—is what certifies deployability. We will release FinSkillBench, its skill packages, verifiers, scorers, and evaluation artifacts upon publication to support reproducible study of these system level effects. Natural next steps include matched cross harness effect estimates, interface identical tool arms that separate tool content from access path, and ontology controlled scoring for categorization tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛地说，可测量的技能溢价并非底层语言模型的内生属性。 它取决于智能体可用的资源、这些资源的暴露方式、交互预算以及评估协议。 因此，智能体基准测试应将资源和工具设计视为科学对象的一部分，而非实现细节。 将相同的子任务整合为一个包含九个阶段的指令执行链，进一步表明：各子任务的接近上限得分未必能组合成整体最优结果——一个运行于自主交接机制上的定制技能智能体，虽然能生成近乎最优但从未完全符合指令的书籍，而每个阶段的控制测试却均显示成功。这凸显出，真正决定部署可行性的，是流程层面、以规范为锚点的合规性测试，而非各项技能的准确性。 在发布时，我们将公开 FinSkillBench、其技能包、验证器、评分器和评估产物，以支持对这些系统级影响的可重复研究。 自然的后续步骤包括：匹配的工具跨工具链效应估计、将工具内容与访问路径分离的接口一致工具分支，以及面向分类任务的受本体控制的评分机制。

paragraphs.en: This work uses only public filings, public market data, and author-constructed synthetic data; no personal, client, or proprietary data is used. The benchmark evaluates analytical correctness in controlled tasks, not suitability for autonomous trading or investment advice. Releasing curated skills may lower the barrier to deploying overtrusted financial agents. We mitigate this by providing deterministic verifiers, evaluation outputs, and documented failure modes. To reduce selective reporting, we also release all scorers and the ten-scheme robustness sweep for independent reproduction and stress testing.
